payload.title: Add the note-search frontend UI
payload.intent: Implement the note-search FRONTEND UI ONLY. This Task is the frontend slice of a larger objective; another Task owns the backend endpoint and is being implemented CONCURRENTLY by a different worker. [Add the note-search frontend UI]
payload.desired_end_state:
Add to `app/static/index.html`:
- a search input with `data-testid="note-search-input"`;
- a results list with `data-testid="note-search-results"`.
Wire `app/static/app.js` to call `GET /api/notes/search?q=<value>` on input and render the results. The backend endpoint is being implemented concurrently by another Task — code against this contract, do NOT wait for it and do NOT implement it yourself.
Add `tests/test_ui_search.py` asserting the served HTML contains BOTH testids (this test must NOT require the backend endpoint to exist).
Do NOT create or edit any backend file. Do NOT touch `app/main.py`, `app/store.py`, or `tests/test_search_api.py` — another Task owns them.
constraints: You may change ONLY these paths: app/static, tests/test_ui_search.py
These paths belong to a DIFFERENT Task and are FORBIDDEN to you: app/main.py, app/store.py, tests/test_search_api.py
Implement ONLY this Task's slice — do NOT solve the complete objective.
